description: This file contains Flask view classes and methods for managing dashboards in the Superset application, including creating new dashboards, listing dashboards, exporting dashboards, and embedding dashboards with server-side rendering.

classes.name: DashboardModelView
classes.description: View class for dashboard operations, including listing, exporting, and permissions management.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: Base view class for dashboard-related actions such as creating new dashboards and embedding dashboards.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Creates a new blank dashboard and redirects to its edit page.

methods.name: embedded
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for embedded dashboards, including access control and logging.
